description: CAM toolpath generation and 3D mesh slicing using CLI engines (PrusaSlicer, OrcaSlicer, Cura).
author: Charon Librarian

generate_gcode.description: Invokes local CAM slicer CLI to generate G-Code toolpaths from 3D geometry.

stl_file.description: Path to input STL or 3MF geometry file.

slicer_cmd.description: Executable name or path for slicer binary. Autodetects if omitted.

profile.description: Optional slicer print profile name or file path.

dry_run.description: Simulate slicing without writing output files.
